buildCommand: npx prisma generate && if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "production" ] || [ "$LZP_PREVIEW_DB_IS_ISOLATED" = "true" ]; then npx prisma migrate deploy; else echo 'SKIPPING prisma migrate deploy: this is a preview and LZP_PREVIEW_DB_IS_ISOLATED is not true. See docs/v2/RELEASE.md.'; fi
_comment_ignoreCommand: R-9.2. Exit 0 SKIPS the build; any non-zero builds. The old form was `git diff --quiet HEAD^ HEAD -- .` — ONE commit — so a push whose LAST commit missed server/ skipped the deployment even when an earlier commit in the same push carried a migration: the schema landed in main and Frankfurt stayed on the old one, with no deployment_status and therefore no smoke run either. VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA is the last commit Vercel actually deployed, so the window is now the whole range. Both guards fail OPEN: an unset variable and a SHA this (possibly shallow) checkout cannot resolve each exit non-zero, which BUILDS. A needless build costs a minute; a skipped one costs a migration nobody notices is missing. .github/scripts/check-deploy-window.mjs reads this very string and fails if it goes back to a single-commit window.
